children: Source: USDA
This summary is based on reports from exporters for the period August 21-27, 2026.

Wheat: Net sales of 313,500 metric tons (MT) for 2026/2027 were down 22 percent from the previous week and 7 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for Mexico (80,400 MT), the Philippines (57,100 MT, including 23,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 60,000 MT), Egypt (35,000 MT), Indonesia (31,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), and Ecuador (30,300 MT, including 30,000 MT switched from Panama), were offset by reductions for Panama (30,000 MT) and Belize (1,900 MT). Exports of 474,800 MT were up 11 percent from the previous week and 2 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Taiwan (100,500 MT), the Philippines (87,100 MT), Mexico (85,600 MT), South Korea (65,000 MT), and Italy (31,200 MT).

Corn: Net sales reductions of 829,600 MT were reported for 2025/2026. Increases primarily for South Korea (138,400 MT, including 126,200 MT switched from unknown destinations), Spain (136,800 MT, including 173,600 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 38,000 MT), Guatemala (80,300 MT, including 59,400 MT switched from unknown destinations, 13,500 MT switched from Honduras, 7,500 MT switched from El Salvador, 400 MT switched from Nicaragua, and decreases of 2,900 MT), Colombia (38,400 MT, including 41,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 2,300 MT), and Mexico (26,700 MT, including 55,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 81,700 MT), were offset by reductions primarily for unknown destinations (721,400 MT), Japan (360,500 MT), Thailand (68,000 MT), Indonesia (67,000 MT), and Canada (32,600 MT). Net sales of 1,986,400 MT for 2026/2027 were primarily for Mexico (665,000 MT), Japan (371,800 MT), unknown destinations (353,300 MT), Colombia (198,600 MT), and Venezuela (80,000 MT). Exports of 1,570,200 MT were up 8 percent from the previous week, but down 12 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (539,000 MT), South Korea (267,400 MT), Spain (226,200 MT), Colombia (194,800 MT), and Japan (173,100 MT).
Optional Origin Sales: For 2026/2027, options were exercised to export 62,000 MT to Japan from other than, the United States.
Barley: Total net sales of 500 MT for 2026/2027 were for Canada. Exports of 1,000 MT were to Canada (800 MT) and Japan (200 MT).

Sorghum: Net sales reductions of 2,600 MT were reported for 2025/2026. Increases reported for China (92,200 MT, including 99,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 6,800 MT) and Mexico (4,200 MT), were offset by reductions for unknown destinations (99,000 MT). Total net sales of 600 MT for 2026/2027 were for Japan. Exports of 96,400 MT were up noticeably from the previous week and from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were China (92,200 MT) and Mexico (4,200 MT).

Rice: Net sales of 57,400 MT for 2026/2027 were primarily for Haiti (22,500 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), Japan (13,000 MT), Honduras (5,000 MT), Colombia (5,000 MT), and Saudi Arabia (4,600 MT). Exports of 44,600 MT were primary to Haiti (20,900 MT), Colombia (9,000 MT), South Korea (4,200 MT), Mexico (3,800 MT), and Canada (2,500 MT).

Soybeans: Net sales reductions of 94,200 MT were reported for 2025/2026. Increases primarily for Spain (42,000 MT, including 55,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 13,000 MT), Panama (5,100 MT, including 4,700 MT switched from Colombia), Malaysia (2,000 MT), Indonesia (1,200 MT, including decreases of 1,300 MT), and Mexico (800 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), were offset by reductions for Egypt (59,600 MT), unknown destinations (55,000 MT), Japan (26,700 MT), Colombia (4,100 MT), and Algeria (700 MT). Net sales of 1,948,400 MT for 2026/2027 primarily for China (972,000 MT), unknown destinations (669,000 MT), Egypt (207,000 MT), Mexico (41,600 MT), and Japan (34,500 MT), were offset by reductions for Venezuela (72,000 MT). Exports of 311,800 MT were down 31 percent from the previous week and 15 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (83,600 MT), Algeria (43,300 MT), Egypt (42,400 MT), Spain (42,000 MT), and Taiwan (25,100 MT).
Exports for Own Account: For 2025/2026, the current exports for own account outstanding balance of 1,800 MT, all Taiwan.

Export Adjustments: Accumulated exports of soybeans to the Netherlands were adjusted down 58,667 MT for week ending July 16 and 58,127 MT for week ending July 30. The correct destination for these shipments is Germany.

Soybean Cake and Meal: Net sales of 29,400 MT for 2025/2026--a marketing-year low--were down 72 percent from the previous week and 68 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for Colombia (26,000 MT, including 27,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 10,800 MT), Guatemala (8,200 MT, including 6,600 MT switched from unknown destinations, 1,900 MT switched from Honduras, and decreases of 500 MT), Panama (6,200 MT, including 6,400 MT switched from Colombia and decreases of 2,100 MT), Vietnam (6,100 MT), and Mexico (5,300 MT, including decreases of 1,000 MT), were offset by reductions primarily for unknown destinations (33,600 MT), Honduras (1,900 MT), Belgium (800 MT), Nepal (600 MT), and Japan (100 MT). Net sales of 701,900 MT for 2026/2027 primarily for unknown destinations (108,000 MT), the Netherlands (100,000 MT), Germany (100,000 MT), Venezuela (93,000 MT), and the Philippines (88,000 MT), were offset by reductions for Panama (30,600 MT). Exports of 197,800 MT were down 39 percent from the previous week and 35 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Colombia (63,200 MT), Mexico (38,100 MT), the Dominican Republic (37,800 MT), Panama (14,900 MT), and Guatemala (13,200 MT).

Optional Origin Sales: For 2025/2026, options were exercised to export 18,000 MT to Ecuador from other than, the United States. The current outstanding balance of 4,000 MT, all Ecuador. For 2026/2027, new optional origin sales of 1,500 MT were for Ecuador. The current outstanding balance of 3,500 MT, all Ecuador.

Soybean Oil: Net sales of 1,300 MT for 2025/2026 were reported for Canada (900 MT) and Mexico (400 MT). Total net sales of 4,000 MT for 2026/2027 were for Canada. Exports of 1,800 MT were down 15 percent from the previous week, but up 31percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were Canada (1,300 MT) and Mexico (500 MT).

Cotton: Net sales of Upland totaling 27,500 RB for 2026/2027 primarily for India (10,800 RB), Vietnam (10,800 RB, including 4,000 RB switched from South Korea and decreases of 300 RB), Bangladesh (5,200 RB, including decreases of 100 RB), Peru (2,000 RB), and China (1,700 RB switched from Hong Kong), were offset by reductions for South Korea (3,800 RB) and Hong Kong (1,700 RB). Exports of 189,500 RB were primarily to Vietnam (77,300 RB), India (22,200 RB), Pakistan (17,800 RB), Mexico (14,700 RB), and Indonesia (9,700 RB). Net sales of Pima totaling 1,800 RB for 2026/2027 were reported for India (1,100 RB), Thailand (500 RB), Pakistan (200 RB), and Japan (100 RB). Exports of 4,600 RB were primarily to Vietnam (1,500 RB), India (1,200 RB), Costa Rica (900 RB), Turkey (400 RB), and Pakistan (300 RB).

Exports for Own Account: For 2026/2027, new exports for own account totaling 7,800 RB were to India. The current exports for own account outstanding balance of 55,800 RB were to India (46,300 RB), Vietnam (9,000 RB), and Turkey (500 RB).

Hides and Skins: Net sales of 286,900 pieces for 2026 were down 7 percent from the previous week and 3 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for China (179,700 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 7,500 pieces), Thailand (32,700 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 1,100 pieces), Mexico (31,600 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 2,600 pieces), South Korea (26,200 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 7,000 pieces), and Italy (6,800 whole cattle hides), were offset by reductions for Taiwan (600 pieces) and Japan (200 pieces). Exports of 322,700 whole cattle hides were up 53 percent from the previous week and 29 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to China (200,100 pieces), Mexico (49,200 pieces), Thailand (31,600 pieces), South Korea (24,000 pieces), and Brazil (23,200 pieces).

Net sales reductions of 9,900 wet blues were reported for 2026. Increases reported for Vietnam (12,700 unsplit), Italy (800 unsplit, including decreases of 100 unsplit), Brazil (800 unsplit), and Germany (300 unsplit), were offset by reductions for Hong Kong (13,200 unsplit) and China (11,300 unsplit). Net sales of 35,200 unsplit for 2027 were reported for Hong Kong (13,200 unsplit), China (11,500 unsplit), and Vietnam (10,400 unsplit). No net sales or exports of other excluding wet blues were reported for the week. Exports of 104,500 wet blues were down 3 percent from the previous week and 23 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Vietnam (39,400 unsplit), Italy (28,400 unsplit), China (16,000 unsplit), Thailand (8,600 unsplit), and Hong Kong (7,700 unsplit). No net sales and exports of splits were reported for the week.

Beef: Net sales of 12,900 MT for 2026 were up 41 percent from the previous week, but down 2 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for South Korea (4,700 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), Hong Kong (1,700 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), Japan (1,600 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), Taiwan (1,600 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), and Mexico (1,100 MT). Exports of 12,000 MT were up 2 percent from the previous week, but 1 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to South Korea (3,400 MT), Japan (3,000 MT), Mexico (1,200 MT), Taiwan (1,000 MT), and Hong Kong (800 MT).

Pork: Net sales of 35,000 MT for 2026 were down 10 percent from the previous week, but up 8 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for Mexico (17,800 MT, including decreases of 400 MT), China (5,900 MT), Japan (2,700 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), South Korea (2,400 MT, including decreases of 400 MT), and Colombia (1,800 MT, including decreases of 400 MT). Total net sales of 100 MT for 2027 were for Japan. Exports of 30,000 MT were unchanged from the previous week, but up 3 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (13,800 MT), Japan (3,900 MT), China (2,500 MT), South Korea (2,400 MT), and Canada (2,000 MT).
